notes.title: Patch beta0.62
notes.content:
Fixed minor bug preventing valid mech builds to be saved

fixed bug in public demo version of Drift Shell that prevented the online lobby menu from being accessible. Now you can setup a private online lobby game in the public demo again

notes.title: Patch beta0.61 - Bipedal Drop Dash Tech and Art Revisions
notes.content:
Gameplay Polish and Art Revisions:


Standard Bipeds can now perform a drop dash. if they land at a fast enough speed high enough to trigger landing stagger tap boost to do a omni-directional dash on the ground. Can be performed during Recharge

Improved APC-CAT Textures

Improved HA-CAT Textures

Improved HNT_BLG Textures

Melee Attacks online now use Attack-Side hit detection

improved UI layout a bit

Changed Local Multiplayer Button to "Arcade Mode"

notes.title: Patch beta0.6 - New Leg type, Painting, Updated mech art
notes.content:
Patch beta0.6

Gameplay Polish and Bug Fixes:

New "Wide Biped" leg type added. double tap - boost to quick boost in any direction in the air

You can now Paint your mechs in the assembly menu! You can choose different sections to paint. save your build with your desired colors and play online to see other player's colorful creations!

New "Auto-Aim" mode provided. The mode comes with restrictions to balance it in PvP. Auto-Aim is activated by pressing, "select"/"share" on a gamepad controller

predicted aim is not thrown off when running target is colliding with a wall. The predicted position on will update along the wall 

predicted aim is not thrown off when running target is colliding with out of bounds wall. the predicted position on will update along the boundary

Online hit detection changed to defender-side

Landing Stagger Added to gameplay

Quad no longer get stopped to do wall kicks off of ceilings

Tanks cannot perform quick-turns anymore

Reverse Joint Legs and tanks are Immune to Landing Stagger 

Added SFX feed back for quick boosts and wall kicks

radar map changed to stand out more from the background so it's clear to read 

Updated part models and textures

updated Lobby Menu layout

Online lobbies will be limited to 2 players in 1v1 mode only at the moment. The other parts of the game are under construction form this update

Temporarily Removed: Match Replays, Settings menu, Faction War quickplay, Team Battles, 4 player Lobbies

notes.title: Patch beta0.55 - New Maps and Collision Overhaul
notes.content:
~Change Log~


 collision system overhauled to allow more freedom in map creation
 Optimized loading times for menus and mech assembly screen to be much quicker
 Implemented camera collision with maps
 Added new maps to conquest mode rotation and multiplayer lobby map selection


4 Maps Total:

 Islands
 Street Tunnel Loop
 Warehouse
 Oceanic Highway



 New photo mode implemented into the Bot Match mode
 'Escape' no longer closes the game it instead pauses the game when in a local match
 Laser Blade damage buffed
 Tank fire rate buffs to Rocket launchers and machine guns lowered
 Tank can fly up when standing stationary
 Tank melee damage buff raised
 Quad boost drain raised
 Reverse Joint boost Drain lowered

notes.title: Patch Beta 0.5: New Quad And Tank Leg options
notes.content:
Drift Shell now has all leg type options Implemented so now I consider the game to be about half way complete content wise. 

My Objective now is to make more Maps, polish the art/presentation, and fill out the Conquest mode experience. all that in time for summer Next Fest in June.

~Change Log~

 Added Quad Legs to mech assembly
 Added Tank Legs to mech assembly
 Added Missile lock timers and a green reticle to indicate a missile lock is being processed
 Speed Missiles can now have up to 4 locks
 Split Missiles can now have up to 2 locks
 Machine Gun Weapon Arms Ammo clip has been increased and damage has been slightly decreased
 Machine Gun bullet Spread increased slightly
 Sniper Rifle's impact push back decreased heavily 
 Fixed a crash due in online lobby due to a client leaving after a game where the host changes the build of a bot player
